title: Back to the board
caption: The quiz Workflow, done by hand once, and now a skill: what to take into your week.

stages.execute: Execute: a quiz page a partner played
stages.improve: Improve: a skill that makes the next quiz

actions.first: Turn one article you’d like your team to learn from into a five-question quiz.
actions.second: Share your quiz page and your prompt with a partner, and compare what each of you got.
actions.third: Use your quiz skill on one more knowledge source at work this week.

question: What matters most when working with agents?

talking-points.description: Walk the board once: each stage was done by hand today, and the skill makes the next run one step. Ask the critical-thinking question, read the three next steps, then open the floor.
